title: Delegate the Entra Policy Suite hybrid worker's gMSA in Active Directory
purpose: Gives the worker's gMSA the right to write exactly the tag attributes (extensionAttribute5-9 by default) on user objects below the OUs you name - one inheritable ACE per OU and attribute, nothing else. Plan first: without -Apply nothing is changed.
whenToRun: Once before the worker is installed, and again when a tag type moves to another attribute or a new OU holds synced users.

runAs.name: an AD admin who may change the permissions of the OUs

changes.permission: WriteProperty on each named extensionAttribute, inherited by descendant user objects
changes.why: the worker writes the tags of AD-synced users

parameters.name: GmsaName
parameters.help: the gMSA's name (sAMAccountName without or with the $)

parameters.name: OrganizationalUnit
parameters.help: the distinguished names of the OUs with the synced users

readsOnly: the gMSA, the schema's attribute ids, the OUs' permissions
whatIf: Without -Apply (or with -WhatIf): every ACE it would add or remove and the ones already there.
